labels.lead: Only what a car wash needs, grouped by task. Everything else is under the button below.
labels.searchPlaceholder: Find a setting: prices, roles, tablet, site…
labels.standardHint: The full EspoCRM settings list (portals, integrations, formulas, extensions…). A car wash rarely needs it.
labels.desc_quickStart: Prices, works, rates and staff in one table, with a completeness check.
labels.desc_washService: Washes and add-ons: retail and contract price, duration, material use.
labels.desc_work: Units of work (body, drying, interior) and the default rate.
labels.desc_workRole: Performer columns in Quick Intake: which and how many.
labels.desc_workRate: Pay for a work: work × service × employee.
labels.desc_translation: Service and work names in four languages.
labels.desc_users: Staff accounts that sign in to the CRM.
labels.desc_roles: Three levels in plain words: what the owner, manager and operator may do.
labels.desc_employees: Washers and specialists: status, position, pay rate, tablet PIN.
labels.desc_kiosk: Issue or revoke a tablet, PIN codes, action log.
labels.desc_shifts: Who clocked in and when, hours worked.
labels.desc_brand: Name, logo, colour, document header and e-mail signature.
labels.desc_templates: Receipt, invoice, act: the wording of printed documents.
labels.desc_siteContent: Pages of the wash's public site, with versions and rollback.
labels.desc_booking: Opening hours, bays, slots, reminders to customers.
labels.desc_clientMessages: "Car ready" and booking messages: channels, keys, test send.
labels.desc_clientAssistant: AI chat on the site: on/off, knowledge, limits and cost ceiling.
labels.desc_mailing: Discount campaigns by e-mail, WhatsApp, phone — consenting customers only.
labels.desc_orderMessage: What was sent to whom about orders: status and errors.
labels.desc_supply: Stock levels, reorder level, unit cost.
labels.desc_supplyReceipt: Deliveries from suppliers; they re-price the average cost.
labels.desc_stocktake: Counting stock, with a required reason for the difference.
labels.desc_supplyMovement: Journal of every stock change — read only.
labels.desc_accountingExport: Sales journal of completed orders: CSV or XML.
labels.desc_fiscal: The cash-register receipt number — on the order card (tab "Extra").
labels.desc_importCustomers: Customers and cars from the old system's CSV: dry run first.
labels.desc_anpr: Plate recognition: nodes, thresholds, photo retention, privacy.
labels.desc_camera: Camera list, snapshot now, live view.
labels.desc_plateEvent: Who was seen at the entrance: confirm, correct, dismiss.
labels.desc_license: Signed module licence: installation id, status, expiry.
labels.desc_backups: How to back up and move the database — commands below.
labels.info_backups:
A backup is made on the server, not in the browser.
./db/dump-full.sh — full copy (schema and data), keep it off the server.
./db/dump.sh — data only, for a new stand.
Details: docs/DEPLOYMENT.md
labels.desc_language: Default language, theme, date and time formats.
labels.desc_assistant: Manager's AI assistant: provider, key, limits, privacy.
labels.desc_accountingIntegration: Completed orders into the accounting program, with a retry queue.
labels.desc_loyaltySettings: Every N-th wash free: how many, what is free, the smallest wash that counts. Points, referral rewards and expiry: settings.
labels.desc_promoCode: Discount codes: percent or sum, period, limits.
labels.desc_promoRedemption: Who used a code and when (read only).
labels.desc_loyaltyLedger: Every change of a customer's points (read only).
